title: EXP-110 - Hello World Part 7 Section 7: Buttons ButtonSignIn, ButtonHome and ButtonCart in the menu Region of FlexLayoutMain on FX_CustomerPortal; Caption Strings FX_sSignIn, FX_sHome, FX_sCart Created Through the Caption Ellipsis; Theme Class FX_BlueButton; Size 15; 2; Readback After Reopen
objective: Follow hello-world-pt7.md Section 7 (10:54-12:08) on the User-scope Form FX_CustomerPortal: place three Buttons, one per task, into the menu region of FlexLayoutMain (EXP-109), top to bottom: ButtonSignIn (Caption FX_sSignIn = Sign In), ButtonHome (Caption FX_sHome = Home), ButtonCart (Caption FX_sCart = Cart). Each caption string is created through the Caption ellipsis; each Button gets Theme Class FX_BlueButton (EXP-064) and Layout Size Width 15, Height 2; one Designer Save per Button. Verify all three after an ordinary close and reopen. Regenerate is not performed; no click events (Part 7 assigns none). Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md (the repository file, at the start of every task), docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt7.md Section 7 (lines 205-217) and transcript lines 10:54-12:08, recipes/components/add-component-from-toolbox.md, recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-109, EXP-106 and EXP-107 records. Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If a session expiry, logout card or sign-in page appears, record it and stop for the operator (EXP-107: the operator signs in manually); do not navigate, type credentials or screenshot a filled sign-in form. Task boundary: do only what the current task instruction lists and stop at its end, even when later steps of this brief remain; report the next step instead of performing it.

Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error.

Designer gate (read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; FX_CustomerPortal open and clean (Save disabled), no dialog open; if it is not open, open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK). Record the Components tree (FlexLayoutMain > Region00: menu empty, then spacer1, signinpage, homepage, cartpage, spacer2; header and footer components unchanged), the Buttons placed so far (none in T1) and where the menu region lies on the canvas (the left column of the main area, left of the first vertical dotted divider).

String collision check (T1, read-only): open Designer Edit menu > String once (Global Objects, Strings filter). Filter FX_sCustomerPortal as a positive control (expected one row, EXP-106), then FX_sSignIn, FX_sHome and FX_sCart (expected no row each). Record the results with one screenshot and leave with Cancel; verify Save is still disabled. If any of the three exists, record its value and stop blocked (the operator decides whether to reuse it).

Efficiency rules (operator, 2026-10-16): screenshots only for the decisive states named in this brief; do not re-open saved images unless a decision needs it; one untargeted snapshot per step; read only the named sources; never search or read the worker's own session transcript. Use inline untargeted snapshots; never save snapshots to files and Grep them (EXP-109 ran out of turns that way).

Button rules (EXP-105, EXP-106, EXP-107): click the Button row in the Toolbox once, then click once inside the menu region on the canvas (below any Button already there, away from edges, dividers and adorner icons). Immediately record the Components tree: the new Button must be a child of FlexLayoutMain > Region00: menu, below the Buttons placed earlier. If it was placed anywhere else, click the toolbar Undo once, record the state and stop blocked. Never drag or reorder. Name: plain fill and Tab. Caption (a string combobox): type the string ID key by key, check that the list shows no other selected item, then Tab (a plain fill plus Tab committed the first list item in EXP-106); verify the committed Caption in a fresh snapshot. String creation: click the Caption ellipsis once; expected prompt 'String <ID> does not exist. Create it?' (record verbatim); Yes once; in the String editor confirm the Name, record the pre-filled value, replace it with the string value by one plain fill and Tab, verify, OK once in the same task. If the prompt names another ID or an editor shows an existing value, change nothing, leave any editor with OK unchanged and stop blocked. Theme Class: open the list, click FX_BlueButton, Tab (if it is missing, record the list and continue without it). Size: double-click the Layout Size row, then Width 15 and Height 2 by plain fill and Tab; record the Size as displayed (expected '15; 2'). At most one correction per field. Then exactly one Designer Save with its response and the Save state. Screenshots: placement with the tree, the creation prompt, the String editor before OK, the Save response.

Button 1 (T2): by the Button rules, place one Button and set Name ButtonSignIn, Caption FX_sSignIn (creating string FX_sSignIn = Sign In), Theme Class FX_BlueButton and Size Width 15, Height 2; one Designer Save. Stop at the end of the task.

Button 2 (T3): by the Button rules, place one Button and set Name ButtonHome, Caption FX_sHome (creating string FX_sHome = Home), Theme Class FX_BlueButton and Size Width 15, Height 2; one Designer Save. Stop at the end of the task.

Button 3 (T4): by the Button rules, place one Button and set Name ButtonCart, Caption FX_sCart (creating string FX_sCart = Cart), Theme Class FX_BlueButton and Size Width 15, Height 2; one Designer Save. Stop at the end of the task.

Readback and audit (T5, one task): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, record the Components tree (the three Buttons under Region00: menu in order), select each Button by its Components row and record Name, Caption, Theme Class and Size, record what the canvas shows (expected: three blue buttons labelled Sign In, Home and Cart stacked in the menu column), and check the three strings read-only through Edit menu > String (filter each ID; Cancel). Leave the Form open and clean. Then, in the same task, write the documentation-only final audit into the record: decisive evidence for each acceptance check, the cumulative action audit with exact counts, the worker-written-file inventory, the cleanup inventory and the final state. Screenshots: the reopened canvas with the tree, and one Strings check.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Coordinates are allowed only for the three canvas placement clicks; record each such click. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection; never leave a prompt, editor or dialog open across tasks. Classify findings as observed only.
